articles.t: Où trouver et acheter le chapeau d'Arthur Morgan dans GTA 6 ?
articles.chapeau: Vous pouvez trouver une très belle référence à Red Dead Redemption II dans GTA 6 avec le chapeau d'Arthur Morgan !
articles.txt:
Vous pouvez trouver une très belle référence à Red Dead Redemption II dans GTA 6 avec le chapeau d’Arthur Morgan !
Les références et easter eggs pleuvent depuis la sortie de GTA 6 . Pour cet opus, Rockstar Games a mis le paquet et on peut tomber sur des petites choses vraiment très sympas, à commencer par le chapeau d’Arthur Morgan , le héros de Red Dead Redemption II , le précédent jeu Rockstar sorti en 2018 sur PS4 et Xbox One.
Voici la petite astuce très rapide pour l’obtenir et pour la modique somme de 35 dollars !
Pour trouver le chapeau d’Arthur Morgan, il faudra atteindre le chapitre 2 du jeu , et pouvoir jouer avec Lucia. Une fois cette seule contrainte débloquée, il suffit de vous rendre à Port Gellhorn, et notamment au sud de la ville ( image 01 & 02 ). Ici, vous tomberez sur un vide grenier ( image 03 ). C’est dans cette brocante que vous allez pouvoir trouver le chapeau.
Une fois devant le vide grenier, il suffit de se rendre devant le canapé blanc ( image 04 ) pour pouvoir interagir avec le chapeau . Il sera possible de l’acheter pour Jason ou pour Lucia pour la somme de 35 dollars . De quoi ajouter un sacré style à votre personnage ( image 05 ) !
C’est un easter egg très sympa qui plaira aux fans de Red Dead Redemption II et qui permettra d’avoir une bonne dose de nostalgie. Ce n’est pas la première référence que Rockstar propose autour de ses anciens jeux dans GTA 6 . Deux très belles références à Grand Theft Auto V et aux anciens personnages est sont également présentes dans les radios du jeu, avec la participation de Trevor (Steven Ogg) dans un podcast !

articles.t: GTA 6 : ça commence, accusé d'être woke, le jeu se fait torpiller par des milliers d'avis négatifs
articles.chapeau: À peine quarante-huit heures après sa sortie triomphale, ce jeudi 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X/S, GTA 6 n'échappe pas au rituel toxique des grosses sorties vidéoludiques. La page Metacritic du jeu est déjà prise d'assaut par des milliers d'avis négatifs, dont une large partie dénonce un virage « woke ».
articles.txt:
Recevez tous les soirs un résumé de l’actu importante avec Le Récap’
Malgré un score critique frôlant la perfection à 99/100 pour GTA 6 , la note des joueurs sur PS5 affiche ce samedi 21 novembre un timide 5,5/10 sur Metacritic , avec plus de 20 300 évaluations négatives (45 % du total) qui viennent contrebalancer les 21 700 avis dithyrambiques. L’écart porte la marque d’un review bombing (une avalanche de notes négatives, souvent coordonnée), même si personne ne peut encore dire quelle part de ces avis a été postée de mauvaise foi.
Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) – PS5 meilleur prix 60 € sur E.Leclerc « Un jeu fait par des femmes, pour des femmes » pour GTA 6 En parcourant les commentaires notés 0 ou 1 sur 10, un refrain revient en boucle chez une frange bruyante d’internautes qui jouent à GTA 6 : Rockstar aurait cédé aux sirènes du « wokisme ». Le duo de protagonistes concentre une grande partie des attaques. Plusieurs utilisateurs s’en prennent violemment à la dynamique entre Lucia et Jason, qualifiant ce dernier de personnage « sans colonne vertébrale » ou de « soumis » face à une Lucia jugée trop autoritaire. Certains vont jusqu’à rebaptiser le titre « simulateur de couple » ou « jeu fait par des femmes, pour des femmes » .
L’évolution du ton et des mécaniques de jeu fâche aussi les nostalgiques de l’ère Vice City ou GTA 5 . Plusieurs avis fustigent un titre devenu « castrateur », reprochant à Rockstar d’avoir bridé certaines libertés historiques de la franchise, notamment l’impossibilité de déclencher des fusillades de masse dans les boîtes de nuit, de faucher des manifestants sur les trottoirs ou de voler des voitures librement dans son propre quartier en début d’aventure. Une auto-censure perçue par ces détracteurs comme une trahison de l’esprit irrévérencieux du studio depuis le départ de ses créateurs historiques.

articles.t: GTA 6, le Premier ministre grec critiqué pour l’avoir suggéré aux jeunes
articles.chapeau: Le Premier ministre grec Kyriakos Mitsotakis a suggéré aux jeunes de demander GTA 6 à leurs grands-parents pour Noël… Sauf que le jeu vidéo trash est réservé à un public adulte
articles.txt:
Alors que le monde entier se rue sur Grand Theft Auto VI, dont les ventes ont atteint le record de 3,79 milliards de dollars en 24 heures , le Premier ministre grec Kyriakos Mitsotakis a été vivement critiqué pour avoir demandé aux jeunes s’ils aimeraient recevoir à noël le jeu vidéo… Réservé à un public adulte.
« Lequel d’entre vous va demander GTA 6 comme cadeau à papy et mamie ? », a lancé l’homme politique, dans un message sur TikTok ce vendredi, avec le logo du jeu apparaissant brièvement à l’écran. « Nous savons tous que les grands-pères et les grands-mères disent rarement non à leurs petits-enfants », a-t-il ajouté.
La publication était destinée à promouvoir une prime de retraite de 400 euros mise en place par le gouvernement conservateur, avant des élections prévues l’année prochaine. Mais le message a été la cible de critiques qui le jugeaient inapproprié, estimant qu’il encourageait des mineurs à acheter un jeu inapproprié.
« Le Premier ministre fait la promotion d’un jeu vidéo interdit aux mineurs uniquement pour être à la mode », a déclaré le Pasok, parti d’opposition socialiste. Le quotidien de gauche Efsyn a qualifié cette décision de « gaffe », tandis que le journal conservateur Dimokratia a parlé d’une erreur « tragique ». Pourtant, la Grèce dirigée par Kyriakos Mitsotakis avait rejoint le nombre croissant de pays qui imposent des restrictions à l’usage des réseaux sociaux par les jeunes.
Comme ses versions précédentes, GTA 6 est un jeu d’action en ligne dans lequel les joueurs arpentent librement une vaste ville, volent des voitures, réalisent des braquages et accomplissent des missions pour des gangs criminels. Comportant une violence intense, du gore, du contenu sexuel, de la nudité, un langage grossier ainsi que l’usage de drogues et d’alcool, il est prévu pour les personnes âgées d’au moins 17 ans.

articles.t: GTA 6 : "J'ai posé deux jours de congé et les enfants sont chez la nounou", ces joueurs qui ont tout organisé pour sa sortie
articles.chapeau: Treize ans après GTA 5, la sortie de GTA 6 provoque un véritable engouement. Certains joueurs ont posé des congés, acheté une console et même organisé la garde de leurs enfants. Dans la région rennaise, Valentin et Rémi...
articles.txt:
Valentin a posé deux jours de congé, jeudi et vendredi, pour prolonger le plaisir jusqu'au dimanche. • © Benoit Thibaut - France Télévisions Benoit Thibaut Publié le 21/11/2026 à 11h15 Temps de lecture : 5 min Bretagne France3 Régions sur Facebook (Nouvelle fenêtre) France3 Régions sur WhatsApp (Nouvelle fenêtre) copier le lien Ajouter comme source préférée Treize ans après GTA 5, la sortie de GTA 6 provoque un véritable engouement. Certains joueurs ont posé des congés, acheté une console et même organisé la garde de leurs enfants. Dans la région rennaise, Valentin et Rémi racontent leurs premières heures dans ce jeu vidéo hors norme.
Il y a ceux qui attendent les vacances pour partir en voyage. Et ceux qui posent des congés pour rester chez eux, manette en main. La sortie de GTA 6, l'un des jeux vidéo les plus attendus de la décennie, est un événement que certains passionnés ne voulaient manquer sous aucun prétexte. Il faut dire qu'ils ont patienté plus de 13 ans depuis GTA 5, sorti en septembre 2013.
Valentin, 32 ans, et Rémi, 22 ans, font partie de ces joueurs qui ont tout organisé pour profiter du nouvel opus de Rockstar Games. Tous deux ont réussi à se libérer le jeudi et le vendredi pour s'offrir quatre jours d'immersion, week-end compris.
Valentin, 32 ans, est commercial dans la région rennaise. Pour lui, la sortie de GTA 6 était inscrite depuis longtemps dans son calendrier. Ancien joueur de GTA 5, il attendait cette suite avec impatience, d'autant que sa sortie avait déjà été repoussée à deux reprises.
"J'attends cela depuis tellement longtemps. J'étais joueur de GTA 5, alors pas question de rater cette sortie." Il a donc posé deux jours de congé, jeudi et vendredi, pour prolonger le plaisir jusqu'au dimanche. Mais pas question de laisser les contraintes familiales perturber son programme.
"J'ai pris des jours de nounou en plus pour mes enfants, pour qu'ils ne soient pas à la maison pendant que je joue. Et ma compagne a prévu de ne pas être là, ou alors juste en observatrice."
Une précaution qu'il justifie avec humour : il ne voudrait surtout pas qu'elle fasse une mauvaise manipulation et compromette sa sauvegarde.
Pour autant, les longues sessions de jeu ne sont plus aussi faciles qu'autrefois. "Je n'ai plus la force de mes 20 ans. J'ai joué quatre heures et j'ai dû faire une pause."
Voir cette publication sur Instagram Une publication partagée par Slash (@francetvslash)
Avec GTA 6, les joueurs plongent dans un immense univers à ciel ouvert, inspiré de la Floride, aux États-Unis. Au cœur du jeu, Vice City, une ville fictive qui ressemble à Miami, avec ses plages, ses gratte-ciel et ses quartiers animés. Mais l'aventure s'étend bien au-delà, entre marécages, petites villes et routes de campagne.
Il y a ceux qui attendent les vacances pour partir en voyage. Et ceux qui posent des congés pour rester chez eux, manette en main pour jouer à GTA 6. • © Benoit Thibaut - France Télévisions Le joueur incarne deux personnages, Jason et Lucia, un couple entraîné dans une histoire de criminalité. Braquages, courses-poursuites, affrontements avec la police… Il faut accomplir des missions pour avancer dans le scénario. Mais la particularité de GTA, c'est aussi sa liberté. On peut conduire des voitures, piloter des bateaux, des avions, explorer les paysages ou simplement se promener pendant des heures. Un monde virtuel immense où chacun peut vivre sa propre aventure, faire du yoga, ou vider les chargeurs de son fusil d’assaut.
Pour accompagner cette aventure, Rockstar Games a fait appel à un grand nom de la musique française : le duo électro Justice. Le groupe a composé la musique originale des missions du jeu, qui fera l'objet d'un album de 30 titres attendu le 11 décembre.
Dès ses premières heures de jeu, Valentin a été impressionné par l'univers proposé. Les personnages, les décors et le réalisme graphique semblent avoir immédiatement répondu à ses attentes.
"On s'attache instantanément aux personnages. Niveau graphisme, c'est du jamais-vu. La frontière entre jeu et réalité est devenue presque imperceptible. On dit ça depuis longtemps, mais là, c'est vraiment réel."
Il a déjà commencé à explorer les possibilités du jeu, entre pilotage d'un hydravion et affrontement avec des trafiquants de drogue dans une ferme. Et il lui reste encore énormément à découvrir.
À 22 ans, Rémi a lui aussi anticipé l'événement plusieurs mois à l'avance. Dès juillet, il s'est équipé d'une console d'occasion, profitant de prix qu'il jugeait plu

articles.t: GTA 6 : 3,79 milliards de dollars dès le premier jour, record officiel - Toutes les Box
articles.chapeau: Take-Two annonce 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes dès le premier jour pour GTA 6, et 32,5 millions d’exemplaires avant la sortie. Les chiffres officiels dépassent les estimations de vendredi.
articles.txt:
Take-Two annonce 3,79 milliards de dollars de ventes au détail dès le premier jour pour Grand Theft Auto VI, et 32,5 millions d’exemplaires vendus avant la sortie. Ce sont les premiers chiffres officiels de l’éditeur, estimés jusqu’à la fin de la journée du 19 novembre, dans le monde entier. Ils dépassent largement les 2,36 milliards de dollars en 24 heures estimés par Sensor Tower, détaillés dans notre article de vendredi . En France, le jeu est à 79,99 € en édition Standard, aussi en boîte chez Cultura .
Dans un communiqué publié le 20 novembre, Rockstar Games, filiale de Take-Two, donne deux chiffres à retenir :
Take-Two précise que le montant de 3,79 milliards de dollars repose sur des estimations internes, arrêtées à la fin de la journée du 19 novembre, à l’échelle mondiale. Le jeu reste noté 99 sur Metacritic, une note déjà abordée dans notre article sur ce record . Il est en vente sur le PlayStation Store, le Microsoft Store, le Rockstar Games Store et chez les revendeurs.
3,79 milliards de dollars dès le premier jour : c’est le chiffre officiel de Take-Two, plus élevé que les estimations de la veille.
Le président et fondateur de Rockstar, Sam Houser, écrit : « C’est avec une immense gratitude que nous entamons un nouveau chapitre de Rockstar Games avec la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI. Nous sommes incroyablement touchés par la réaction des joueurs dans le monde, et nous avons hâte de partager ce moment avec vous. »
Lucia et Jason en cabriolet à Vice City, dans une image officielle du jeu. © Rockstar Games Plus haut que les estimations de vendredi Vendredi, les premières estimations de Sensor Tower donnaient plus de 2,36 milliards de dollars et 24,59 millions d’exemplaires en moins de 24 heures, pour un objectif de 3 milliards dans les semaines à venir. Le chiffre officiel de Take-Two dépasse déjà ces deux bornes, dès le premier jour.
L’écart s’explique surtout par le périmètre : Sensor Tower s’appuie surtout sur les boutiques numériques de Sony et Microsoft, alors que Take-Two compte aussi les ventes en magasin, dans le monde entier, jusqu’à la fin de la journée de lancement. Les 32,5 millions d’exemplaires « pre-release » ne sont pas le même indicateur que les ventes du premier jour : ce sont les unités déjà vendues avant le lancement, d’après l’éditeur.
Take-Two rappelle aussi le poids de la licence : GTA V a dépassé les 235 millions d’exemplaires, et la série Grand Theft Auto approche les 480 millions d’unités. Ces volumes, eux aussi, viennent du communiqué officiel.
Le jeu reste disponible uniquement sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Le communiqué ne donne aucune date pour une version PC ni pour le mode en ligne. La boîte vendue en magasin contient un code de téléchargement, et le fichier pèse jusqu’à 212 Go. Pour comparer les prix en France, voyez notre comparatif .
On a enfin le chiffre de l’éditeur, et il est plus élevé que ce que l’on avançait vendredi. Cela confirme que GTA 6 a eu le lancement le plus rentable de l’histoire du divertissement, selon Take-Two. Deux nuances restent utiles. D’abord, 3,79 milliards de dollars sont des estimations d’entreprise, pas un audit public détaillé par plateforme ou par pays. Ensuite, sans version PC ni mode en ligne pour l’instant, le premier jour ne dit pas encore quelle sera la durée de vie du jeu.
Pour acheter le jeu en boîte, rendez-vous sur la page GTA 6 PS5 de Cultura .

articles.t: GPU à +33,65 % sur 90 jours, GTA 6 et DDR6 : la semaine GinjFo - GinjFo
articles.chapeau: GPU à +33,65 % sur 90 jours, GTA 6 disponible, DDR6, Windows 11, test NZXT H5 RGB+ et bon plan MSI : la semaine GinjFo.
articles.txt:
Cette semaine a été riche en évènement allant des mouvements de prix à un lancement très attendu en passant pas mal de nouveautés matérielles. Nous avons parlé de GTA 6, des premières orientations de la DDR6, en passant par une mise à jour facultative de Windows 11 sans oublier un test complet d’un boîtier NZXT. Voici ce qu’il ne fallait pas manquer sur GinjFo du 14 au 21 novembre 2026.
Une nouvelle fois le marché des cartes graphiques fait parle de lui avec une petite surprise positive. Au 20 novembre, l’ Observatoire des prix GinjFo affiche pour les GPU un indice de 133,65. Par contre nous avons un léger recule de 0,81% sur sept jours. La hausse reste cependant de 10,68 % sur 30 jours et de 33,65 % sur 90 jours.
Les autres familles évoluent beaucoup moins. L’ indice CPU reste à 100, sans changement sur sept jours, tandis que l’ indice RAM atteint 103,69, soit +0,09 % sur sept jours et +3,69 % sur 90 jours. Côté SSD , l’indice est à 100, stable sur sept et 30 jours.
L’attente est enfin terminée pour les joueurs sur console. GTA 6 est désormais disponible sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S , mais quelques précautions évitent une mauvaise surprise.
Il n’existe toujours pas de version PC ni de date annoncée pour cette version. Sur Xbox One, l’accès passe par le cloud et non par une version native. Enfin, le jeu n’est pas inclus dans le Game Pass. Il faut l’acheter séparément.
Le JEDEC a précisé les pistes de travail autour de la DDR6 . Le changement le plus visible serait physique avec des modules de 74 mm, environ 44 % plus courts qu’une barrette DDR5 actuelle .
La feuille de route évoque aussi 12,8 GT/s au lancement des RDIMM, puis 14,4 GT/s et davantage, avec un bus porté de 64 à 96 bits. À 12,8 GT/s, le débit théorique atteindrait 153,6 Go/s.
Microsoft déploie KB5132057 pour Windows 11 25H2 et 26H2 . Cette mise à jour facultative rassemble les résultats de recherche dans une liste unique et prépare une nouvelle boîte de dialogue « Exécuter ».
Le correctif s’attaque aussi à l’avertissement erroné signalant qu’un autre utilisateur emploie encore le PC, ainsi qu’à des problèmes touchant Miracast et l’authentification par passkey depuis Android.
Le dossier de la semaine est notre test du NZXT H5 RGB+ . Affiché à 139,90 €, ce boîtier aquarium mise sur quatre ventilateurs aRGB, une vue panoramique à 270°, un dessus vitré et le Control Hub Lite piloté par CAM.
Microsoft commence à lever le voile sur le Project Helix, la prochaine Xbox . La machine reposerait sur Windows avec une interface pensée pour le salon. Elle exécutera des jeux PC tout en assurant une rétrocompatibilité couvrant quatre générations de Xbox.
XPG décline l’INVADER X MINI Chroma en quatre finitions. Malgré son nom, le boîtier accepte les cartes mères ATX, micro-ATX et Mini-ITX, ainsi qu’une carte graphique de 330 mm, et fournit cinq ventilateurs aRGB de 120 mm.
Le bon plan le plus convaincant au moment de notre relevé concerne le MAG CoreLiquid E360 noir à 79,99 € .
Cet AIO s’arme d’un radiateur de 360 à trois ventilateurs de 120 mm, un éclairage aRGB et une compatibilité avec les sockets AMD AM4/AM5 et Intel LGA 1700/LGA 1851.

articles.t: The 9 best things to do in the first 10 hours playing GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Don't let your first 10 hours of GTA 6 go to waste!
articles.txt:
GTA 6 is finally here and it's easy to get overwhelmed by the many options it throws at you. Here's a handy guide to help.
There’s a lot to do in GTA VI and once you finally step foot into the game’s beefy open-world it’s easy to become overwhelmed by choices.
My first 10 hours with the game consisted of story missions, side-activities and generally just soaking in the vibes of Leonida.
But, after nearly 90 hours with the game by this point I’ve got a lot of wisdom to impart, so below are XX things to see and do once you’ve beaten GTA VI’s speedy prologue.
When you first get control of Jason you’ll notice his home is in disarray. Fortunately, the game lets you fix his place up in a way that’s reminiscent of the infamous house-building segment in Red Dead Redemption 2.
You can replace the stairs, mend the roof, paint the walls and more, and there’s an added incentive of Lucia being very pleased with you for going the extra mile.
Rockstar Games knew exactly what it was doing when it put GTA VI’s military base just down the road from the game’s opening area.
It’s an instant temptation as you can see jets flying overhead as you approach. Be warned though, stealing a jet or tank is nowhere near as simple as it was in GTA V, and you’re probably going to die – a lot.
While the game encourages you to stick around Key Lento for the first chapter, you’re not forced to.
The map is completely open by the time Jason is free to explore, which means you can immediately head to Vice City and visit the NINE1NINE strip club. Or check out the other tourist spots I guess…
GTA VI brings back body composition and Jason has a pretty sweet weight-lifting set-up on his porch.
Once free roam unlocks though you can visit any gym, pay for a membership and sculpt your physique to your liking. Or, you can skip the gym entirely, eat your feelings and watch your protagonists get doughy.
I’ve sunk (haha, get it?) a shameful amount of hours into the fishing so far, but it’s just so much fun.
Jason’s friend Cal challenges you to catch bigger fish than him, and will send you all across Leonida’s waters to do so. You’re free to fish wherever you like though.
You unlock this just after Jason gets reunited with Lucia, and it’s an integral part of the game. You’re given several saving milestones to hit, and I’d encourage you to start saving early if you can.
Save your cash for yourself of course, but when you’re done raiding Kingfisher outposts or selling cars, be sure to put a little aside to get into the habit.
In true Rockstar Games fashion GTA VI has some supernatural secrets stashed away in Leonida, and one can be found near Pelican Valley, which isn’t far from the game’s opening area.
You’ll know him when you see him, and once you do it kicks off one of the game’s best side-missions…
One of the most-rewarding parts of GTA VI is the blossoming relationship between Jason and Lucia, and the player has near-complete control over their affections.
Holding hands, sharing a smooch or even treating each other to ice cream all contribute to the way they feel about each other. It’s genuinely lovely.
As tempting as it can be to jump straight into free-roam, let me assure you that the story mode is 100% worth it.
It’ll also unlock new opportunities as you progress, so while you’re free to explore at your leisure you should try getting to at least Chapter 3 before committing hours, and hours and hours to it. You’ll have way more options by then.

articles.txt:
Ils ont troqué la tisane et les parties de Scrabble pour se défier… à GTA 6 . Le jeu tant attendu de Rockstar Games disponible depuis jeudi est venu troubler la routine des résidents de l’établissement pour seniors Domitys de Serris (Seine-et-Marne), une ville plus coutumière de l’univers de Disneyland Paris − dont elle est la voisine −, que de « Vice city » .
Ou plutôt, des résidentes. Jacqueline, 82 ans, semble la plus à l’aise au milieu de ce décor et ses eaux turquoise inspiré de Miami. En pilotant son bateau, elle doit mettre la main sur… de la cocaïne.

articles.t: Plus fort qu'Avengers, Avatar, Spider-Man ou L'Odyssée : GTA 6 affiche déjà 3,8 milliards !
articles.chapeau: En cumulant précommandes et ventes du premier jour, le jeu vidéo signe le plus gros lancement de l'histoire du divertissement, tous médias confondus.
articles.txt:
En cumulant précommandes et ventes du premier jour, le jeu vidéo signe le plus gros lancement de l'histoire du divertissement, tous médias confondus.
Cette année, Spider-Man est monté sur le podium des plus gros succès de tous les temps en glanant 2,5 milliards de dollars de recettes avec Brand New Day . Quelques jours plus tôt, Christopher Nolan a frappé aux portes du top 10 du même classement historique, en explosant son record personnel avec L'Odyssée et ses 1,8 milliards de dollars au box-office mondial. Et en décembre prochain, Avengers : Doomsday va certainement mettre tout le monde d'accord avec une pluie de billets verts biblique... 2026 est une année faste pour les salles obscures. Mais comparé à GTA 6 , ce n'est pas grand chose.
Le jeu vidéo vient de faire exploser tous les compteurs : 3,79 milliards de dollars générés par ses précommandes et ses ventes lors de sa première journée de commercialisation. Un chiffre annoncé ce vendredi par Rockstar Games , qui revendique déjà le plus gros lancement de l'histoire du divertissement. Ni plus, ni moins.
Selon Take-Two Interactive , la maison mère du studio, ce résultat constitue "un nouveau record dans le divertissement, tous médias confondus" .
L'éditeur présente ainsi le sixième épisode de sa franchise comme " le plus grand lancement de l'histoire du divertissement ".
Il n'a toutefois pas souhaité communiquer le nombre d'exemplaires écoulés mais on serait autour de 33 millions de jeux vendus déjà. Il faut rappeler que Grand Theft Auto V s'est vendu à près de 235 millions d'exemplaires et a généré près de 11 milliards de dollars de recettes cumulées depuis sa sortie en 2013.
Pour mesurer l'ampleur du phénomène, les 3,79 milliards de dollars, c'est à peu près les recettes cumulées des deux derniers films Avatar de James Cameron , La Voie de l'eau et De feu et de cendres . En une seule journée, le jeu dépasse également les 2,9 milliards de dollars attribués à Avengers : Endgame , présenté comme le plus gros succès de l'histoire du cinéma.
Il faut souligner que les coûts de production sont aussi bien plus élevés que pour un film : on parle d'un montant de 1,5 milliard de dollars pour financer plus de 10 ans de production.
Surfant sur des notes historiquement hautes - 99 sur Metacritic par exemple - GTA 6 devrait aussi décrocher le titre de jeu de l'année aux Game Awards, en décembre prochain, boostant un peu plus ses ventes.
De quoi donner le vertige à Sam Houser , président et fondateur de Rockstar Games , qui a salué l'accueil réservé au jeu :
" C'est avec une immense gratitude que nous entamons un nouveau chapitre de Rockstar Games avec la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI. Nous sommes incroyablement touchés par la réponse des joueurs du monde entier et nous ne pourrions pas être plus heureux de partager ce moment avec vous. "
Le lancement du jeu le plus attendu de tous les temps affole les compteurs : trafic Internet record et près de 8 millions de spectateurs simultanés sur Twitch, YouTube et Kick.
Le patron de Take-Two Interactive, maison mère de Rockstar Games, n'exclut pas d'adapter un jour la célèbre franchise en film ou en série. Mais il faudra trouver la bonne histoire.
Depuis 50 ans, Première défend une certaine idée du cinéma. Aidez-nous à faire vivre cette histoire et à écrire les 50 prochaines années (t-shirts collectors, abonnements, affiches, rencontres...).

articles.t: GTA 6: PC gamers welcome unofficial PC port despite potential damage to the industry
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 is finally here, but PC gamers are still waiting – at least for an official release. An unofficial PC version could already be on the way. Despite the potential damage such recompilations could do to the gaming industry, the prospect has been met with largely positive reactions online.
articles.txt:
On the day GTA 6 launched, hacker Cyberleek released large portions of the Xbox version , potentially paving the way for an unofficial PC port. The process in question is known as recompilation, which involves adapting a game's code to run on another platform. Cyberleek believes modders could get the game running on PC within a week. On Reddit , the otherwise controversial hacker is receiving plenty of support – despite the potential harm such releases could cause to game developers.
PC gamers are clearly frustrated about having to wait for GTA 6 . However, the enthusiasm surrounding the prospect of an unofficial PC version arriving so soon appears to be driven largely by resentment toward Rockstar's long-standing strategy of releasing its games on consoles first and PC later. Many users accuse Rockstar of deliberately encouraging players to buy the same game twice. Those eager to play GTA 6 at launch may purchase the console version, only to buy it again on PC later to enjoy improved graphics. Some commenters have even openly stated that they intend to play the unofficial port. Others hope that rapid progress on the recompilation will put pressure on Rockstar to bring forward the official PC release.
Whether the unofficial port will actually be playable next week remains uncertain. Modders are still missing a crucial file: the game's executable (EXE), without which it cannot be launched. Cyberleek says he plans to release it on November 23, but whether that will be enough to produce a working PC version so quickly remains to be seen. There are also broader concerns about the potential consequences of such recompilations. If newly released games become available for free on other platforms shortly after launch, developers could lose valuable revenue. For smaller studios in particular, those losses could threaten their survival. Over time, this could make it harder to finance new games and encourage publishers to introduce stricter always-online requirements – ultimately leaving players worse off as well.

articles.t: GTA 6 : peut-on jouer avec un volant sur PS5 et Xbox ?
articles.chapeau: Peut-on jouer à GTA 6 avec un volant Logitech, Thrustmaster ou Fanatec ? Voici ce que révèlent les premiers tests sur PS5 et Xbox.
articles.txt:
Avec ses nombreuses routes, ses véhicules et son immense monde ouvert, GTA 6 pourrait être un formidable terrain de jeu pour les possesseurs de volants. Malheureusement, nos premiers essais sur PlayStation 5 se sont révélés décevants : aucun de nos volants n’a fonctionné.
Depuis sa sortie le 19 novembre 2026, GTA 6 permet enfin aux joueurs de découvrir les routes de Vice City et de l’État de Leonida. Entre les voitures de sport, les grosses berlines américaines et les nombreux véhicules disponibles, difficile de ne pas avoir envie de brancher son volant pour profiter de ce gigantesque terrain de jeu. C’est justement ce que nous avons essayé de faire chez Univers Simu, avec plusieurs volants pourtant parfaitement compatibles avec la PlayStation 5.
Résultat : aucun des volants que nous avons essayés ne fonctionne dans GTA 6. Le jeu ne semble tout simplement pas prévoir leur prise en charge. Impossible, dans ces conditions, de profiter de la conduite avec un véritable volant et un pédalier, encore moins d’un retour de force digne de ce nom.
Nos essais montrent que posséder un volant compatible PS5 ne suffit pas pour jouer à GTA 6. Il faut en effet distinguer la compatibilité d’un périphérique avec la console de sa prise en charge par un jeu. Cette dernière nécessite que les développeurs aient prévu les commandes et les fonctionnalités correspondantes.
Reste à savoir si Rockstar Games décidera d’ajouter la prise en charge des volants dans une prochaine mise à jour. Rien ne permet pour l’instant de le garantir. Si des adaptateurs capables d’émuler une manette peuvent éventuellement offrir une solution de contournement, ils ne remplacent pas une compatibilité native, notamment en matière de retour de force.
C’est d’autant plus dommage que GTA 6 possède un véritable potentiel pour les joueurs qui aiment simplement conduire et explorer un monde ouvert . Parcourir Vice City avec un volant, respecter la circulation ou partir en balade sur les routes de Leonida pourrait offrir une expérience particulièrement immersive.
Pour le moment, il faudra donc se contenter de la manette. Et vous, aimeriez-vous pouvoir parcourir GTA 6 avec votre volant de simracing ?

articles.txt:
Vous venez de lancer GTA 6 et vous ne savez pas vraiment par où commencer ? Entre l’immensité de Vice City, les nouvelles mécaniques de gameplay et les innombrables activités proposées par Rockstar Games, il est facile de passer à côté de certaines fonctionnalités importantes. Voici notre Starter Guide GTA 6, garanti sans spoiler, pour bien débuter votre aventure à Leonida.
Sorti le 19 novembre 2026 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S, Grand Theft Auto VI est certainement l’un des jeux les plus ambitieux jamais réalisés par Rockstar Games. Après plus de dix ans d’attente, les joueurs peuvent enfin découvrir une nouvelle version de Vice City et explorer l’État fictif de Leonida. Un monde ouvert immense, rempli de détails, mais aussi de systèmes de gameplay qui ne sont pas toujours expliqués immédiatement.
Contrairement à GTA 5, ce nouvel épisode accorde davantage d’importance à certaines mécaniques de simulation. La gestion de l’argent liquide, les véhicules, la réputation criminelle ou encore les interactions avec les habitants peuvent avoir des conséquences sur votre expérience. Certaines habitudes héritées des précédents GTA méritent donc d’être revues.
Précision importante : ce guide ne contient aucun spoiler sur l’histoire de GTA 6. Nous ne dévoilerons ni les missions, ni les événements du scénario, ni les surprises cachées dans le monde du jeu. Les seuls éléments évoqués concernent des fonctionnalités de gameplay et les deux protagonistes, Jason et Lucia, déjà présentés officiellement par Rockstar.
Avant même de commencer à explorer Vice City, un passage par les paramètres du jeu peut considérablement améliorer votre expérience. GTA 6 apporte plusieurs changements dans les commandes, notamment pour les déplacements à pied, la visée et la conduite. Les joueurs habitués à GTA 5 risquent d’ailleurs d’être un peu surpris lors de leurs premières minutes.
Premier changement important : le sprint utilise désormais le stick gauche (L3 sur PS5, LS sur Xbox) dans la configuration par défaut . Si cette nouvelle disposition ne vous convient pas, vous pouvez modifier les commandes dans les paramètres. Prenez également le temps d’ajuster la sensibilité de la caméra, l’assistance à la visée et les options de sous-titres.
Les paramètres graphiques et la luminosité HDR méritent aussi quelques ajustements, particulièrement si vous jouez sur un téléviseur récent. La conduite occupant une place centrale dans l’expérience, vérifiez également les réglages de caméra en voiture. Quelques minutes de configuration peuvent vous éviter des heures de frustration.
C’est probablement la première tentation : lancer GTA 6, récupérer une voiture et traverser l’intégralité de Leonida pour découvrir les paysages. Pourtant, ce n’est pas nécessairement la meilleure façon de commencer.
Comme dans les précédents épisodes, Rockstar introduit progressivement ses mécaniques à travers les premières missions. Certaines fonctionnalités, possibilités d’interaction et activités ne deviennent accessibles qu’après avoir suffisamment avancé. Partir trop tôt à l’aventure peut donc vous faire manquer des outils qui faciliteront grandement votre exploration.
Notre conseil est simple : progressez un peu dans l’introduction avant de vous lancer dans une exploration approfondie . Une fois familiarisé avec les principaux systèmes, vous pourrez profiter bien plus librement du monde ouvert. Il n’est absolument pas nécessaire de vous précipiter dans la campagne principale pour autant.
GTA 6 dispose d’un système de sauvegarde automatique, mais cela ne signifie pas que vous devez lui faire entièrement confiance. Dans un monde ouvert où les situations peuvent rapidement dégénérer, disposer de plusieurs sauvegardes constitue une précaution particulièrement utile.
Pour enregistrer manuellement votre progression, ouvrez le menu pause, puis recherchez l’option de sauvegarde dans la rubrique consacrée au jeu. L’idéal est de conserver plusieurs emplacements distincts plutôt que de systématiquement écraser la même sauvegarde.

articles.txt:

The day before Grand Theft Auto 6's launch, like many gamers, I returned to Grand Theft Auto 5's Los Santos for one last ride. Within moments of booting up my multi-hundred-hour save, I was causing chaos with a bazooka before switching to a devastating portable mini-gun. It was the stuff of pure GTA carnage; extreme violence, utterly gleeful in its sheer absurdity.
The next day, I spent the majority of my first hour with GTA 6, trying to decide what color to paint the protagonist's bedroom walls, fixing the leaky roof, and replacing rotting wooden planks on a staircase, before unwinding by shooting some hoops in my front yard and going for a gentle kayak. I'd swapped being a one-man army for being a domesticated virtual boyfriend.
I enjoyed my day of digital DIY significantly more than becoming the city's most wanted. And that's what makes GTA 6 a game-changer. It has literally changed the way I game. If previous Grand Theft Autos were sprawling sandboxes, ripe for wanton destruction, GTA 6's Vice City is the first Rockstar Games world I don't want to destroy; I just want to exist in.
GTA 6 is still a Grand Theft Auto game, so the option to go on a rampage is very much present. If you want to play your Jason and/or Lucia as a murderous psychopath that robs every gas station they find, terrorizes ordinary citizens, and is hunted by the Vice City Police Department, Rockstar Games won't stop you (though such criminal actions will be reflected in your "Criminal Profile," which reportedly has narrative consequences).
Much to my surprise, I just haven't felt the desire to engage in random acts of violence. Instead, I've been content to take my time, observing the world at a slower pace as a law-abiding citizen. I've even been obeying traffic laws!
But much to my surprise, as noted above, unlike in GTA 5, I just haven't felt the desire to engage in random acts of violence. Instead, for the majority of my five hours with the game so far (a playtime that should swell significantly over the weekend), I've been content to take my time, observing the world at a slower pace as a law-abiding citizen. I've even been obeying traffic laws!
The DNA of Red Dead Redemption 2 has most definitely bled into GTA, and in my book, that's a very good thing. Like that 2018 masterpiece, actions in GTA feel deliberate, and the level of detail in environments and how you can interact with the world is staggering. I can't think of another AAA game that has made me want to work out, wolf down a protein bar, and take a shower afterwards. It's not so much digital escapism as living a virtual second life.
I'm typically a goal-oriented player; I like having something to do at all times. Which means with a lot of games, I find myself mission-hopping, neglecting to enjoy the setting in the process. With GTA 6, I've done the exact opposite. I've barely made any story progress, because I've been losing myself in Jason's local neighborhood, pottering around shops, sitting by the beach drinking a smoothie, or taking to the ocean to see what sea life I can find.
The reason for my change in approach is probably that GTA 6 looks absolutely incredible on PS5 Pro . Yes, the 30 fps cap is disappointing, but the visual quality makes up for it. When an open-world setting looks this stunning and is rendered in such rich detail, perhaps it's only natural to want to experience it as a real human would, rather than viewing it as a sandbox.
Maybe at some point, I'll get bored of just existing in Leonaida (and I haven't even been to Vice City yet), and then I'll be glad to have the story missions to funnel me through over-the-top action set pieces. But at this early stage in my playthrough, the biggest joy that GTA 6 has brought me hasn't been from stealing cars or robbing convenience stores, but just taking a lazy stroll.

articles.t: I Tried Being a Law-Abiding Boyfriend in GTA 6, Until a $6 Beer Forced Me Into a Life of Crime
articles.txt:
I'm relationship-maxxing GTA 6. Forget the money, the cars, or building a criminal empire. My main aim is to make Jason and Lucia so disgustingly loved up that NPCs violently vomit as we walk past being all cute together. I want them to be the perfect couple. I want romance. I want devotion. I want the sort of relationship that makes everyone else in Vice City feel deeply inadequate.
Unfortunately, the nuanced way GTA 6 tracks even the smallest actions has turned me into a paranoid lunatic, constantly worrying that one wrong move will destroy my carefully cultivated romance. Case in point: a $6 beer that sent me into a cascade of disasters, petty crime, and emotional turmoil, eventually ending with me restarting an entire mission because I was worried I'd blown it.
Early on in the game, you're given the chance to prepare the house and complete some simple objectives ahead of picking Lucia up from prison. Naturally, I did them all. Fixed the steps, bought the necklace, got the flowers. I even made sure the car was dent-free, had a haircut and a shower, and dressed my Jason in his best jeans and shirt. My man was going to look presentable when he picked up the love of his life. I was on my best behavior. Nothing was going to stop me getting to my girl.
In fact, I was so determined to be the perfect boyfriend that I even avoided committing any crimes on the way to the prison. In Grand Theft Auto. I obeyed traffic laws. I stopped at red lights. I avoided trouble wherever possible, to the point that when a random NPC tried to mug me, I just handed over my cash rather than risk getting into a fight. Remember that last part. It's important.
After picking Lucia up from prison, you head straight to the Rusty Anchor for a few drinks. So far, so good. We've got the flowers, the necklace, the freshly showered boyfriend. This is going brilliantly. Then Lucia wanders off for a moment and asks Jason to get her a drink.
Shit. I have no money. Suddenly, my decision to be a law-abiding citizen has come back to bite me in the arse. I gave all my money to a mugger because I was trying to be a good boyfriend, and now I can't afford to buy my girlfriend a beer. A beer that costs just $6.
Surely this is a relationship test? If I follow Lucia without her drink, am I getting a little broken heart icon? Is this going into some invisible ledger of romantic failures? Have I already failed as a boyfriend, future husband, and potential co-parent because I can't produce one lousy alcoholic beverage?
I start looking for solutions. I check every bottle in the bar, hoping I can just grab one and pretend I've paid for it. They're all empty. I search the entire building for something I could quickly pawn, like a trading card, or even just some random cash someone has carelessly left lying around. Nothing. The panic is setting in.
I head outside and start searching the nearby streets. I don't want a wanted rating, because surely being arrested while Lucia waits patiently for a drink isn't going to do wonders for our relationship either. So I look for cars with trunks I can break into easily. I find a selection of sunglasses and hats, which is lovely, but unless Lucia has suddenly developed a taste for drinking accessories, they're not going to help me.
I'm now seriously considering mugging someone. I only need $6. Six. Dollars. That's barely a crime, right? In the grand scheme of GTA, that's practically community service. I pull out my gun and start advancing on a random NPC walking down the sidewalk. I'm about to threaten an innocent stranger with a deadly weapon so I can buy my girlfriend a beer. This is what love looks like, apparently.
And then it happens. The game suddenly switches to a cutscene of Lucia saying, "You forgot about me?" NO. NO! The opposite! I was thinking about you the entire time! I needed $6 for a beer, light of my life! I was prepared to commit armed robbery for you! Does that mean nothing?
But the damage is done. Or at least, I think the damage is done, which is somehow worse. Has the game registered that I wandered off and abandoned Lucia? Does she think Jason is an inconsiderate arsehole? Have I just knocked several invisible points off my perfect relationship score? It wouldn't be Grand Theft Auto 6 without some vehicles to thieve. Whether you're looking to fence some cars for cash or fill out a garage with your collection, IGN's Vehicle guide has a list of planes, trains, and automobiles just waiting for you to snatch up.
You need to discover at least 200 Vehicles to fulfill GTA 6's 100% requirement , and fence $100,000 worth of Vehicles . You'll want to make your score unrecognizable before you try to sell it off, and that's where Pay 'N' Spray shops come in. Some police heat is nothing a little paint job can't fix. There are also ten Vehicle Challenges to complete.
There are 277 Vehicles in GTA 6, and 281 Standout Vehicles to discover on top of that.
Below you can find a sortable list of Vehicles you can find in GTA 6, with statistics on speed, handling, and more:
Cars now have a visible “ body condition ” meter, which functions similarly to a health bar. You can view this while driving by pressing D-pad Down on the D-pad. Look for the circular meters above the map to check the vehicle’s condition.
Vehicles also now have a gas meter , which you can see beside the body condition meter. You'll need to refuel your vehicle when it gets low on gas by pulling up to a gas pump at a gas station.
If you’re driving an electric vehicle, you’ll have to find yourself a charging station instead, although you’re unlikely to encounter electric vehicles much in the early hours of the game.
There are plenty of ways to repair your vehicle in Leonida (and trust me, you’re going to need ‘em).
You won’t be able to sell cars until you meet Moses Watkins in Chapter 2 . After completing his mission by stealing and retrieving an ’82 Crawler for him, he’ll offer to fence any untracked cars that you bring him. Even better, he gives you a Slim Jim , which you can use to bypass the locks on cars without having to smash the window and trigger an alarm.
Whenever you steal a car, pull up the map and hover over Moses’ shop on the map. You’ll be able to see how much the car will sell for when you bring it into his shop. Alternatively, if you really like the car and want to keep it for yourself, you can also see how much it will cost for you to register the car as your own personal vehicle .
Occasionally you’ll receive texts from Moses asking you to boost specific cars. These usually pay extra and also come with a condition bonus if you manage to bring the car into his garage in good condition. It’s a great and relatively low risk way to make money, especially in Chapter 2.
Once you complete the Daily Driver mission, Moses rewards you with a garage in Port Gellhorn which you can now use to store one more vehicle!
With storage facilities unlocked, you also get the Vice City Real Estate app unlocked for use on your phone, which allows your characters to purchase more garages around Leonida. Each new property varies in cost (starting at $5,000), and each property offers you one more storage location each.

articles.t: GTA 6 PC Port Leak: 209 GB Xbox Dump, No Emulator
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 PC port leak: Cyberleek 209 GB Xbox dump lacks its executable, and no Xbox Series X|S emulator exists. What is verified and what is not.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games The GTA 6 PC port leak story took a sharper turn on November 21, 2026, two days after the console launch. A leaker calling itself Cyberleek says it put a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI into circulation, and XDA Developers reported the claim as an unverified release of a dumped build. Nobody has confirmed the files are real. The reported dump also lacks the main executable, so the game cannot start.
That gap is the whole story. Cyberleek says the community will turn an Xbox build into a PC game within a week, yet reports describe no working Xbox Series X|S emulator that could run it. Our earlier report on the dump covered what appeared on the leaker’s site. This analysis asks a different question: how far is a 209 GB Xbox archive from a playable Windows version, and what do the headlines get right and wrong?
We tie every claim below to a named outlet, and we separate what the reports state from what only the leaker asserts. Rockstar Games has not officially announced a PC port, according to the coverage we reviewed. Everything about a PC route to the game remains speculation for now.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Cyberleek claims to hold a November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI and says it is distributing the archive by torrent. PCMag reported the claim on November 20 and described a download of about 209 GB that the group says contains a decrypted Xbox build. VGTimes added that a link on the group’s site carried a label reading XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026), and that journalists had seen the site itself.
The timing matters. Reports place the post on November 19, the same day the game reached PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. A leak that lands on launch day maximizes attention, and that pattern fits a group that has spent months building an audience around Rockstar’s biggest release.
PCMag also reported that the archive appeared to include files tied to Rockstar’s RAGE engine and Xbox files connected with AMD graphics technology. That detail suggests the listing looks like a real console package, though a convincing file tree proves little by itself. File listings and screenshots are easy to stage, and a name on a folder is not a working game.
Cyberleek also drew a line between this release and a PC release. Its own wording, as quoted by GamesRadar, admitted that this is an Xbox build and not a PC build. We come back to that admission below, because it changes how readers should weigh the PC port framing that dominates search results.
Most of what circulates today is a claim about a claim. Outlets such as PCMag, GameSpot, IGN and Gamereactor UK report that Cyberleek says things, and several note that they could not check the files. The table sorts the main points by how well the coverage supports them.
The pattern is clear. Only two things hold up across outlets: a leaker made public claims, and the reported package cannot launch without a file the leaker withholds. Authenticity sits at the bottom of the confidence scale. The Ma-no.org write-up said Eurogamer could not confirm that the advertised files exist, and The GTA 6 Map reached a similar conclusion in its own coverage.
An executable is the program that loads everything else. Game data, models, audio and scripts sit in archives, and the executable decides how to read them and when to run them. Without it, the 209 GB of reported content is a very large pile of assets with no way to start.
GameSpot reported that the absent executable prevents the build from launching as a playable game. Cyberleek itself describes holding that single file back on a countdown. The group’s framing is that every other file is out and only the launcher is held, a tactic that keeps attention on the story for days.
Assets alone can still interest people. Modelers, datamining communities and analysts can inspect meshes, textures, map files and configuration data if the files are real and readable. That kind of material feeds speculation videos and wiki pages. It does not produce a running game.
A console executable also differs from a Windows one at the instruction and system level. An Xbox title targets a fixed hardware platform and a specific operating environment. Even with the executable in hand, a PC release would need either a translation layer or a rebuilt codebase. That brings us to the part of the claim that gets le

articles.t: 'GTA 6': How to listen to the radio outside of a vehicle
articles.chapeau: Rockstar introduced a fantastic new feature to "GTA 6."
articles.txt:
One of the most important aspects of any Grand Theft Auto game is the soundtrack , and for the first time in the series, GTA 6 doesn't require players to be in a car or near a radio to listen to it.
Rockstar Games went above and beyond licensing dozens of existing bangers across almost any genre you can imagine for GTA 6 's in-game radio stations, and that's before you even get to the fantastic original score from Justice. However, one small limitation of previous games in the series was that you couldn't really enjoy all of that music while walking around.
Thankfully, Rockstar Games took a cue from how people listen to music in 2026. Here is how to listen to music in GTA 6 without driving a car.
In real life, most people have a pair of headphones or earbuds handy so they can listen to music on their phones. GTA 6 joins some other open-world action games like Watch Dogs 2 in allowing players to use virtual headphones to jam out to some tunes from a smart device while simply walking around the world. The best part is that you can do this from a very early point in the game, though it will require a little bit of in-game money.
Protagonist Jason Duval is perhaps the only guy in Leonida who doesn't own headphones of any kind at the start of GTA 6 , so you'll have to go buy some. This can be done at any electronics store in Vice City and the surrounding areas, and you'll know a store sells headphones if the store's icon on the in-game map is a pair of headphones. Convenient!
Unless you really branch out right away and decide to explore the whole map before getting on with the story, the easiest way to get headphones at the start is to drive up north from Jason's neighborhood to the town of Hamlet. Some of the early main story missions will take you there, anyway. What you're looking for is a store called Zeke's Electronics on the north side of Hamlet.
Simply go in and you'll be able to buy either over-ear headphones or earbuds next to the cash register. Over-ear cans will run you about $200, while earbuds cost $119. I can't tell if there's a meaningful difference between the two aside from looks, so just go with whatever you like more.
Once you have your headphones, simply hold left on the D-pad to listen to the radio while outside of a car. I recommend the Dirty South Classics station, personally, but your mileage may vary. Recommended deals for you HBO Max — top pick for premium content
Alex Perry is a tech reporter at Mashable who primarily covers video games and consumer tech. Alex has spent most of the last decade reviewing games, smartphones, headphones, and laptops, and he doesn’t plan on stopping anytime soon. He is also a Pisces, a cat lover, and a Kansas City sports fan. Alex can be found on Bluesky at yelix.bsky.social .

articles.t: Cyberleak's leaked GTA 6 build runs into a wall: there is no Xbox Series X|S emulator - Gamereactor
articles.chapeau: Cyberleak says it is torrenting a full Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI and that PC players could emulate it within a week, but no working Xbox Series X|S emulator exists.
articles.txt:
The hacking group Cyberleak says it is distributing a full November 2026 Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI by torrent and claims that PC players could have the game "emulated inside a week" , a promise that runs straight into a technical wall: no working Xbox Series X|S emulator exists.
Cyberleak said in a 19 November post that it holds the full Xbox build and that the files were going out by torrent immediately. Early looks at the release from members of the hacking community suggest it is genuine but missing the launcher .EXE file needed to run it, and Cyberleak says that executable is "held on a countdown" until 23 November unless its crypto token reaches a $15 million market cap first .
The malware archive vx-underground, which inspected the torrent, says the files contain actual GTA 6 assets and that people could be playing on PC by Monday if the .exe drops on the 23rd as promised.
> wake up > take a shit > get out of bed > check beep boop > over 9000 DMs > "SCHMEELI, GTA VI LEAK" > ??? > sends link > torrent > ok > look inside > actual assets > huh > squint eyes > look closer > not larp huh, how about that. the cyberleek guy released the full xbox gta 6… pic.twitter.com/1MDrGI97Dy
The week-long timeline is Cyberleak's own claim, and it deserves scepticism for two reasons. First, the group has a documented history of using previous GTA 6 leaks to pump a $250,000 cryptocurrency scheme, so its stated dates are best treated as claims rather than scheduled events.
Second, and more fundamentally, emulation may be the wrong word for what would follow an executable release. No working Xbox Series X|S emulators yet exist, so there is no ready-made route from a dumped Xbox build to a playable PC version. A working unofficial port would instead depend on recompilation, converting the console code to run natively on PC, a far slower and less certain path than the frame rates Cyberleak touts.
GTA 6 launched on console on 19 November, and Rockstar has not announced a PC version at all. Rumours point to an official port in early 2027, and former Rockstar technical director Obbe Vermeij has argued the studio would benefit from releasing a PC port early given the rise of AI-assisted ports. Cyberleak, whose name appears as "Cyberleek" in some syndicated headlines, says that if the Xbox build does not lead to a PC port, it would pursue a PS5 build instead.
Rockstar has made no statement on the leak. Cyberleak says the Xbox executable will follow on 23 November regardless of the crypto scheme's outcome.

A leak with a price tag Cyberleak has tied the early release of the launcher to its own crypto token reaching a $15 million market cap, promising a November 23 release regardless, as the threat was first reported on November 20 . No PC version has been announced, and rumors point to an official port early in 2027. The malware archive vx-underground, which independently inspected the torrent and found actual game assets with the launcher missing, says an emulated PC version could follow within days of the .EXE appearing.
Everything about the dump rests on Cyberleak’s own statements, and the group’s past behavior suggests the financial incentive behind the leak matters more than any release schedule. articles.t: 'Overrated Game': GTA 6 PS5 Review Bombing Has Started After Record-Breaking Release | Push Square
articles.chapeau: "More like Slop Theft Auto"
articles.txt:
GTA 6 , the highest-rated game of all-time , is getting review bombed on Metacritic as idiots attempt to plunge the seminal Rockstar release’s rating with bogus ‘0’ scores.
At the time of writing, the title has a user score of 5.4 , meaning it’s considered ‘Mixed or Average’:
This is in sharp contrast to critics, who awarded the game an average score of 99, making it the best-reviewed title of all time.
“Good thing Rockstar doesn’t blacklist user ratings like they do critics,” one review reads.
There’s a theory among some online that the dev blacklists media outlets for giving its games poor scores, but it put GTA 6 in the hands of more than 150 critics, so I don’t buy that for a single second.
Many of the ‘0’ reviews all touch on the same thing: 30fps is “unplayable”, the series has gone “woke”, and the “story is horrible”. (“I never smiled one time,” writes one seemingly perpetually miserable user.)
There are some legitimate criticisms among these; one person writes they’re not a fan of the life sim elements and prefer the “power fantasy” of older games. That’s fair, but it doesn’t make it a ‘0’.
Metacritic reviews have always been a disaster really, because you don’t need to actually own a game to rate it. Many of the best titles ever released have dreadful user scores on the site.
On the PS Store , though – where you actually have to spend money on the game to score it – the current rating sits at 4.84 based on 170k reviews. So that’s probably a better reflection of how the community feels.
My take on all this is that humans are predictable creatures: wherever there’s something popular, you’re probably going to find a group of people eager to tear it down.

articles.txt:
PC players are still waiting for GTA 6, but a leaker claims that could change within days. The prediction follows the release of files described as an Xbox build of Rockstar’s game.
There is a large gap between that claim and a playable PC version. The main executable is reportedly missing, and we have not seen independent proof that the leaked material runs as a complete game on a computer. Rockstar has not announced a PC release date.
Cyberleek, the name behind earlier GTA 6 leaks, says the community could have the game running on PC within a week once the missing file is available. That is the leaker’s prediction, not a timetable from Rockstar or a demonstrated result.
GTA 6 is available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Image: Rockstar Games
PC Gamer reports that Cyberleek claims to have released a November Xbox build while withholding the executable. The leaker has tied the file’s release to a cryptocurrency promotion and has also claimed it will be released on November 23.
The reported leak is described as an Xbox build, not an official PC release. Image: Rockstar Games
Security research group vx-underground says it examined the files and found game assets. It also speculated about PC play if the missing executable appears. That is still conditional, and it does not show that an unofficial PC build is ready.
Another developer, OptiJuegos , noted that the game uses Microsoft’s Game Development Kit and shares architecture with Windows. The observation may explain some of the optimism, but shared technology alone does not establish that a console build will work on a PC.
Rockstar has not confirmed when the game will arrive on PC. Image: Rockstar Games
Even if the missing file appears, people working on an unofficial version would still have to make it run. Compatibility, performance and stability would be open questions, and Cyberleek’s claims about timing or frame rate should not be treated as verified results.
There is also a security reason to be cautious. NordVPN’s researchers warn that scammers are using fake GTA 6 PC downloads as bait. Do not enter account details or run an unfamiliar installer simply because it promises early access.
For now, the supported ways to play are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Amazon sells a boxed PS5 edition , but it contains a download code rather than a disc. The listing says the code requires a US or Canadian PlayStation account; it is not a PC copy.
If you are waiting for an official PC release, I would watch Rockstar’s announcements before making plans around any date. A leaker’s confidence is not the same as a working release.

The hacker behind the 2022 Grand Theft Auto VI breach claims to have released a dumped Xbox build of the game online.
The individual, who uses the handle "teapotuberhacker," posted on an online forum claiming to have released a dumped Xbox build of the game. No one has verified the claim, and Rockstar Games has not commented on the alleged release.
A dumped build typically refers to a copy of a game extracted from development hardware, such as an Xbox dev kit, rather than a retail disc. Such builds often include debug menus, unfinished assets, and unencrypted code that retail versions lack.
The leaker posted more than 90 videos of early GTA VI gameplay online in September 2022, along with source code from Grand Theft Auto V. After the breach, the FBI and the City of London Police opened a joint investigation. Police arrested the individual, and a court found him guilty of multiple charges tied to the 2022 breach and other cyberattacks. The court sentenced him to an indefinite hospital order.
Viewers of the 2022 leak already saw large portions of the game's early development, including its Vice City-inspired setting and two playable protagonists. Developers debated security practices at major studios in the leak's aftermath.
If the new claim holds up, a full build shared outside Rockstar's control would mark a more serious breach than the 2022 footage leak, which consisted of video clips rather than playable code. Security researchers have warned that leaked builds can contain proprietary engine code, asset pipelines, and authentication systems. Exposure of those materials creates risks beyond copyright infringement.
Rockstar Games has not responded to requests for comment. The company said it was disappointed by the 2022 leak but that the incident would not affect the game's development timeline.

Patrick has a BA in journalism from Toronto Metropolitan University. Sign in to your XDA account Summary A purported November 2026 Xbox build of GTA 6 is circulating online via torrents. Cyberleek says they will release the missing executable after a countdown completes, or earlier if their crypto hits a $15 million market cap. They claim PC emulation of GTA 6 is already running at about 30fps. In the latest twist in the race to get GTA 6 unofficially running on PC, Cyberleek, the same person or group behind leaks surrounding the game from earlier this year , claims to have released a November 2026 Xbox build of the game. According to reports, the game files are available online via torrents (via Videocardz ).
Users on Reddit report that the leak features roughly 209GB of data. Screenshots of the directory structure are also circulating online. I haven't verified that the torrent is available (it's likely being shared through private trackers), but based on reports from various Reddit users, a build of GTA 6 (or at least files that look like it) seems to be out there.
Cyberleek says they'll release the missing executable file once a countdown expires, but that they'll drop it early if their shady Cyberleek cryptocurrency reaches $15 million in market capitalization.
Cyberleek says this is the game's Xbox build and that the community will have it "running far past 30fps" in a week. However, they haven't shown the game running smoothly on PC or provided a technical explanation for how this would be possible. The group also mentions they were able to get their hands on a PS5 build of GTA 6 if they can't get the Xbox version running on PC. This suggests that PS5 firmware version 26.07-14.23 , which is required to play GTA 6, has already been cracked (or Cyberleek may have gotten the files from another source).
It's important to note that Xbox game files can't just be run on Windows. Although the Xbox Series X/S and modern Windows PCs use the same x86-64 CPU architecture, Xbox game files can't just be launched on a PC. Developers would need to figure out the console's encryption and recreate or replace the Xbox-specific system functions and graphics, similar to the efforts to get the Switch 2 Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake running natively on PC .
It's important to note that none of Cyberleek's claims have been independently confirmed. Earlier this week, an X user created a fake video showing GTA 6 booting on PC. The clip is actually just a performance overlay of the PS5 version of GTA V running on a computer, layered over GTA 6 's opening title screen.
While GTA 6 is now available on the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, Rockstar has not announced a PC version. Rumors point to an official PC release arriving somewhere between six months and a year from now, similar to GTA V .

articles.t: GTA 6 Lummox County Rocket Location: SERA Link Unconfirmed
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 Lummox County rocket location: where the symbol sits on the Goodtime State map, what SERA means in leaks, and what Rockstar has not confirmed.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games A small rocket icon on a printed map has GTA 6 players combing every corner of Leonida. According to Indiatimes , the symbol sits in the northern section of Lummox County on the illustrated Goodtime State map that comes with the GTA 6 Collector’s Box. The GTA 6 Lummox County rocket location exists on paper. What it marks in the game, nobody outside Rockstar Games can say.
The hunt landed one day after launch. As our coverage of the global rollout that began in New Zealand showed, Grand Theft Auto VI unlocked region by region on Nov. 19, and players have spent the hours since scanning every pixel for secrets. The rocket draws extra attention because leaked development material reportedly names an organization called SERA, listed beside entries about a failed space launch.
Here is the short version for November 20, 2026. The rocket is on the map. The SERA entries are in the leak material. Rockstar has linked neither to the other, and no verified evidence says the rocket marks a SERA facility or a place where players can watch a launch. The sections below separate what is documented from what is theory, and they flag every gap.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Start with the narrow facts. Grand Theft Auto VI takes place in Leonida, and the searched reports describe a rocket symbol printed on the Goodtime State map. That map is an illustrated piece inside the GTA 6 Collector’s Box. It is artwork first and a navigation aid second, if it is a navigation aid at all.
Indiatimes places the symbol in the northern part of Lummox County. It sits near the boundary with Kelly County, and it appears to the right of a monster-truck illustration. That is the full list of positional clues in the reporting. No one has published coordinates, a road name tied to the icon, or a caption that explains what the rocket stands for.
The absence of a caption matters. Maps in games and in collector packaging often carry decorative flourishes next to real landmarks. A monster truck beside a rocket could point to two attractions in the same region, or it could simply be two pieces of flavor art drawn to fill white space. The reporting does not settle that question, and neither does this article.
Rockstar Games has not put out an on-record statement about the symbol. The available results contain no confirmed product price tied to the story, no launch date for any rocket-related content, and no rocket specification. Everything beyond the printed icon is interpretation, and readers should treat it that way.
If you own the Collector’s Box, or you have seen photos of the poster, finding the rocket takes a minute. Locate Lummox County first. Follow the county to its northern edge, then look for the border with Kelly County. The rocket icon sits close to that line, to the right of the monster-truck art.
Use the monster truck as your anchor, since it is the largest illustration in that corner. The rocket appears to its right. Because the icon is small, a high-resolution photo helps far more than a thumbnail. Once you find it, compare its position against the county boundary lines to confirm you are looking at Lummox and not a neighboring area.
The table shows how little is nailed down. Five rows describe where the icon sits. One row, the one that matters most, says nobody knows what it represents. That imbalance explains why the story spread so fast. A precise position paired with a blank meaning invites exactly the kind of theorizing the community loves.
Players want a waypoint. A printed poster cannot give them one. The Goodtime State map is a stylized illustration, so scale, distances and even relative placement may bend to suit the art. A rocket drawn near the Kelly County line could sit a few miles from that line in the game, or it could sit nowhere, as a purely decorative nod.
Think about what a poster designer needs. The piece has to look good on a wall, balance its colors, and give each county a recognizable identity. Icons serve that goal. A monster truck says something about the region’s character. A rocket might say the same thing about a space-flavored corner of Leonida. Neither icon has to correspond to a mission marker or a collectible.
Beyond that, an in-game map and a souvenir map answer different questions. The in-game map tells you where to drive. The poster tells you what the world feels like. Trea

articles.t: CyberLeek Returns and Has Reportedly Released a Complete Version of Grand Theft Auto 6 via Torrent, Potentially Facilitating Piracy and Emulation | LEVEL UP
articles.chapeau: The infamous hacker (or group) claims it will share GTA 6’s executable file if its cryptocurrency reaches a value of $15 million
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is finally available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, bringing an end to a 13-year wait filled with all kinds of controversies. Leaks were among the biggest challenges Rockstar Games faced, and it seems the company will have to keep dealing with them.
Believe it or not, the hacker or group known simply as CyberLeek is back and promises to cause more trouble. This time, it claims to have released a complete version of the game through Torrent and has threatened to share the executable file, which could potentially make piracy and emulation easier.
Earlier this year, CyberLeek began sharing a series of supposedly 100% authentic videos showing the game in action. The leaks appeared just days before Rockstar Games released the extended GTA 6 trailer on Netflix.
The hackers supposedly advocate for consumer rights, criticizing some of the practices employed by Take-Two Interactive and other major video game publishers. However, their image as vigilantes fell apart when the community noticed that all the leaked material included links to purchase a cryptocurrency.
In other words, it was clear that CyberLeek was making money from the situation. The group even allowed users who purchased its digital currency to choose which leaks would come next. This entire situation prompted Rockstar Games to launch an investigation, which is still ongoing.
The hackers abruptly stopped their leaks in mid-October, but at the time, they warned that they would return at a later date to reveal Grand Theft Auto 6 spoilers and punish the companies behind the project. It remains to be seen whether they will follow through on those threats, but apparently, they are back with another attack.
According to reports, CyberLeek has once again posted a supposed GTA 6 leak on its website. This time, the group allegedly shared a build of the Xbox version, and the files have reportedly begun circulating through Torrent.
The alleged leak has already appeared on social media and forums, with some users claiming to have downloaded the Torrent file, which supposedly weighs around 209 GB. People have started sharing screenshots of its contents, but it appears that the main executable file is missing.
The authenticity of the material has yet to be verified. However, if it turns out to be real, Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive will have to deal with the lingering risk that the hacking community could emulate the game on Microsoft’s platform and encourage piracy.
CyberLeek returns with another alleged Grand Theft Auto 6 leak.
In a statement, CyberLeek threatened to release the missing executable file at a later date. It remains unclear what would happen if the file became publicly available, but it is expected to make emulation and piracy easier to some extent.
In the same message, the organization or hacker behind these attacks claimed to have the complete November 2026 version of Grand Theft Auto 6 and said it was already being distributed through Torrent. It also stated that the executable file would be released sooner if its cryptocurrency reached a value of $15 million, half of the original $30 million target announced a couple of weeks ago.

Image: Rockstar Games A day after Grand Theft Auto VI reached players, the anonymous leaker known as Cyberleek is back with a claim that has the gaming press scrambling. According to IGN’s report , the persona has allegedly released a near-complete Xbox build of the game, while holding one crucial file back for now. The Cyberleek GTA 6 leak is the top gaming story on November 20, 2026, and it is also a story with very little verified detail attached.
Reports describe a download of roughly 209GB, labeled “XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026)”. The package reportedly lacks the main executable, which means nobody can run it today. Cyberleek ties the release of that file to a $15 million market capitalization for its own cryptocurrency token, and also names a calendar date, November 23, 2026, as the day the executable goes out no matter what the token does.
We covered the first wave of this story in our earlier piece on the alleged 209 GB Xbox build and the missing executable . This analysis takes a different angle. It focuses on the countdown, the financial lever Cyberleek is pulling, what the leak could and could not mean for the game’s launch, and how readers should separate fact from noise over the next three days. Every specific below comes from the named outlets and the verified record. Where the record is silent, we say so.

The alleged files are described as an Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI, labeled “XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026)”. Outlets including IGN, Eurogamer.net, PC Gamer, Notebookcheck and VideoCardz have all published on the claim, and Nacionale and Wolf’s Gaming Blog have carried it too.
Eurogamer’s headline frames the drop as a full development build of the game , and describes the group as infamous and back after an earlier appearance. That word “back” matters. It tells readers the persona has a history of making claims about Rockstar’s work, and the press is treating this release with both attention and caution.
The size figure comes up in nearly every report. A package of about 209GB is large enough to resemble a real console game install. Size alone proves nothing, though. A torrent of that weight could contain genuine game data, a mix of old and new material, or filler. No outlet in the verified record says it ran the build, inspected it file by file, or matched it against a retail copy.
The package also reportedly carries a name in the usual release-group style, with the build number and the Cyberleek tag attached. Naming conventions like that are free to copy. Anyone can label a file anything. That is why the story, as of today, rests on what Cyberleek says and what outlets have relayed, not on what independent analysts have tested.
The detail that gives this story its shape is the missing main executable. Reports say the alleged package does not include it, so the build cannot be launched as it stands. Cyberleek’s own framing is that everything else is out and one file waits on a countdown.
From a pure leverage standpoint, this is a clever structure. A leaker who dumps every file at once has nothing left to bargain with. A leaker who holds back the single piece that turns data into a running program keeps attention, keeps pressure and keeps a reason for people to come back. IGN’s headline captures the tension directly, saying the leaker is holding a crucial file back for now and threatening to release the game’s executable within days.
An executable is the entry point. Without it, the assets, scripts and libraries sit on disk like parts without an engine block. That is why reporters describe the package as unplayable today. It does not follow that the rest of the files are worthless. Data can be studied, compared and mined for information even when no one can run the game.
